title: Mark Bible Quiz - Chapter 16
description: Ten questions on Mark 16: the women at the open tomb, the young man in the white robe, the risen Lord appearing and the sending out of the disciples.

questions.text: Who bought spices to come and anoint him when the Sabbath was past?
questions.explanation: When the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices so that they might come and anoint him.

answers.text: Mary Magdalene, Martha and Salome
Mary the mother of James, Salome and Joanna
Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome
Mary Magdalene, Salome and the mother of Joses

questions.text: What were the women saying among themselves on the way to the tomb?
questions.explanation: They were saying among themselves, "Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?"

answers.text: Who will roll away the stone for us?
Who will give us more spices?
Who will open the city gate for us?
Who will tell the disciples?

questions.text: What did the women see when they looked up at the tomb?
questions.explanation: The stone was very big, and when they looked up they saw that it was rolled back.

answers.text: The tomb sealed with wax
Soldiers standing guard
A light shining inside
The stone rolled back

questions.text: Whom did the women see when they entered into the tomb?
questions.explanation: Entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe, and they were amazed.

answers.text: Two soldiers guarding the door of the tomb
A young man in a white robe sitting on the right side
Peter and John standing inside the tomb
Jesus standing by the door of the tomb

questions.text: What did the young man tell the women about Jesus the Nazarene?
questions.explanation: He told them not to be amazed, that Jesus the Nazarene who had been crucified has risen and is not there, and he showed them the place where they laid him.

answers.text: That he had been taken away
That he was still being prepared for burial
That he has risen and is not there
That he would come to the tomb at evening

questions.text: Whom were the women told to go and tell?
questions.explanation: He told them to go and tell his disciples and Peter that he goes before them into Galilee, where they will see him, as he said to them.

answers.text: His disciples and Peter
The chief priests
The young men at the tomb
No one at all

questions.text: What did the women do when they went out from the tomb?
questions.explanation: They went out and fled from the tomb, and said nothing to anyone, because trembling and astonishment had come on them and they were afraid.

answers.text: They sang praises to God on the way back
They went back to the city for more spices
They waited at the door for the disciples
They fled and said nothing to anyone, for they were afraid

questions.text: To whom did he appear first after he had risen early on the first day of the week?
questions.explanation: He appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.

answers.text: To the eleven at the table
To Mary Magdalene
To two of them walking into the country
To Peter alone

questions.text: What did he tell the eleven to do?
questions.explanation: He said to them, "Go into all the world, and preach the Good News to the whole creation."

answers.text: Stay in Jerusalem and wait for him
Return to their fishing in Galilee
Go into all the world and preach the Good News
Say nothing until he returned to them

questions.text: What happened to the Lord after he had spoken to them?
questions.explanation: So then the Lord, after he had spoken to them, was received up into heaven, and sat down at the right hand of God.

answers.text: He was received up into heaven
He returned to the tomb outside the city
He stayed with them in the house
He was hidden from their sight at the table
